queries: WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The set of observatories is every row in the observatories table, so an observatory with no telescopes counts as 0 telescopes and is included in the average share (the average then equals 1 / number of observatories).
The total number of telescopes equals the sum of per-observatory counts, since every telescope has a non-null foreign key to an observatory.
The share is computed as a non-rounded decimal (count * 1.0 / total) to avoid integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Only observatories that actually have at least one telescope are considered, so the average share is taken over those stations only.

The share's denominator is the total number of telescopes, taken as the sum of the per-station counts. Every telescope belongs to an observatory because of the NOT NULL foreign key.
